# Every distinct window title recorded for claude 2.1.325 and codex 0.169:
# the "title" of each screen dump and the OSC 0/2 sequences of the pty logs
# of the row3 and q13 sessions.
#
# Fields, separated by one tab: runtime, busy, action required, title. The
# title is the rest of the line and may be empty (a final tab is optional).
# The expected readings come from what the sessions showed, not from the
# package: a spinner glyph first means busy (claude: U+25D0 and U+25D1; codex:
# U+2800 to U+28FF); for codex the words "Action Required" mean an open
# approval prompt; claude never sets action required, and its U+2733 title
# shows when idle and at an approval prompt, so it sets nothing.
